title: Self-Retracting Tie-Down Strap – Heavy-Duty Cargo Strap with Automatic Retraction
descriptionHtml:
Tangled tie-down strap that takes forever?

Regular tie-down straps tangle in the cargo space, work loose during transport and take forever to thread and tighten. And loosely secured cargo is directly dangerous on the road.

Pull out, hook on – done

The self-retracting strap pulls out exactly the length you need and winds itself back in automatically. No tangles, no loose end – just quick, secure fastening of cargo every time.

Features

  • Automatic retraction – winds itself in, no tangles.
  • Heavy-duty construction – holds heavy cargo in place.
  • Free length adjustment – pull out just as much as you need.
  • Sturdy hook – quick and secure attachment.

Changing your mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
